verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own marketing says its in-app assistant Brain² learns each user's and team's tone, shorthand, and preferences, which matches every element of the story, and Super Agent is described with 'infinite memory.' The support is a single marketing line, with no documentation of how the learning works or how it shapes output. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how tone and preference learning works and how users control it, explicit evidence that output is tailored as a result, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output

citations.quote: Brain² learns how you and your team talk: your tone, your shorthand, your preferences.
